outputEncoding: Each record.outputsRef resolves to its exact normalized outputs array in outputSets. Keys are SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and comma/colon separators. Identical arrays are stored once; all measured values and original record file digests remain per trial.
interpretation: All 12 trials include ten new matches, fresh processes/empty directories, no output reuse; all normalized slot/result/chunk/checkpoint hashes agree. No missing spans or dropped records.
Wall medians: 41879.022 -> 41716.420 ms (-0.39%). All five paired differences are retained.

Three of five paired candidate trials are slower; the -0.39% median wall difference is within observed variation and does not establish a speedup. Median process CPU increases by about 1.29%. The pool placement/lifetime change is a bounded scheduling foundation, not demonstrated end-to-end acceleration.

Both variants perform 30 complete validations. Candidate runs 10 writer-seal validations on main and 20 bundle/public producer validations through the same two Piscina threads used by calculation. Verification Worker spans include dispatch/wait, file reads, decode and validation; they are not CPU-only timings. Fine-grained main-thread decode spans no longer cover the two Worker passes; the validation call accounting includes them.

Pool ownership lasts through producer reconciliation; batch execution borrows the same pool. Separate partition CLI invocations still create separate pools. No multi-partition runner assignment is implemented here.

Process CPU includes every Worker. The calculationWorkerCpuMedianMs field covers calculation tasks only, not verification tasks; do not add it to process CPU. Inclusive spans overlap and cannot be summed into wall or CPU.

The two-admission/40MiB publication window, one serial publisher and all durability/byte/privacy checks remain. The shared pool adds at most one waiting task, including on one-Worker hosts. 3/4-Worker throughput and actual GitHub runner scaling remain unmeasured.
WAL still checkpoints TRUNCATE ten times per trial. No checkpoint threshold change or crash-safety/performance comparison is claimed.
Five real official-20-v2 battlefields, both placements, guardian/fire-mage, one seed and unchanged rules/budget. This partial local pilot does not cover all 20 characters/7600 slots.
Startup/input planning/output comparison, GitHub setup/artifacts/waits, network/R2/Pages are excluded. No end-to-end 270/300-second acceptance or 16/32-runner decision follows.

Peak process RSS includes setup. Worker memory and DB/WAL/SHM are sampled maxima, not exhaustive peaks. Final directory sizes are post-run, not disk high-water marks. save.read failure counters are expected missing-file probes; trial success requires completed verified results.
Candidate SHA is the exact clean runtime commit used in the trials, not the later evidence-only commit.

reproduction.instructions: Check out plan.baseline and plan.candidate separately, install each frozen pinned toolchain, extract the exact driver/runner strings into a scratch directory, and adapt only runner workspace paths. Retain the registered order and 120-second timeout. Run node --import tsx DRIVER REPOSITORY OUTPUT.json from each apps/cli directory. Never mutate a measured checkout or run tests/other simulations concurrently. Raw receipts retain the actual original commands and directories.
